constructed_generation.interpretation: Independent constructed, reachable, full-board positions; not completed games.

extra_positions_import.proof_verification: External proof provenance and label consistency checked; certificates not replayed.

policy_constraints_import.proof_verification: Independent legal source replay and complete defender-branch verification; no search and no trusted verified flags.

split.augmentation: D4 and simultaneous color/side exchange after game split

initialization.interpretation: Initialize model weights only; optimizer, learning-rate schedule, epoch numbering and checkpoint selection start fresh.

limitations: Search imitation from bounded trajectories, not an unbeatable-play proof.
Held-out games select the checkpoint; no independent match claim.
Value labels describe the played continuation, not minimax truth unless search-proven.
